name: email_change_confirm

metadata.description: Email change confirmation sent to the new address with a fully resolved frontend link.
notes: `user` is a dict (user.to_dict('basic')) representing the current account holder.
`new_email` is the new email address and is also the recipient of this message.
`token_url` is built server-side from tenant/project WEBAPP_BASE_URL and WEBAPP_AUTH_PATH settings, then may be shortened.
The confirmation token has a 1-hour TTL and is single-use. Redeeming it rotates active sessions.

text_template:
Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

A request was made to change your account email address to:
{{ new_email }}

Open this secure link to confirm the change:
{{ token_url }}

This link expires in 1 hour. Once confirmed, all other active sessions will be signed out for your security.

If you did not request this change, you can ignore this email. Your current email address will remain unchanged.
html_template:
Confirm your new email address

Hello{% if user.display_name %} {{ user.display_name }}{% endif %},

A request was made to change your account email address to {{ new_email }}.

Confirm email change

If the button does not work, copy and paste this link into your browser:

{{ token_url }}

This link expires in 1 hour. Once confirmed, all other active sessions will be signed out. If you did not request this change, ignore this email.

Sent by Django-MOJO
